dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Is this your lair... Sorry, your home?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Such a huge world hidden inside such a tiny teapot. It's just like how Simulanka is contained within a book.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Well, though this place is just as new and unusual...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: It's different from when I first arrived in Sumeru or Mondstadt. I don't feel that mix of excitement and unease. I feel safe and comfortable here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's good to hear. If you need anything, just let me know!

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Thank you, but... but this place already has everything. I don't need anything more.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: If anything, there's too much. Some things will be wasted on me.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: For example, the soft bed that you prepared for me. Perhaps it could go to another guest who needs it?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: And don't worry, I haven't used it.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I'll fold the bedding and put it back in the closet. A very capable maid taught me how to do it, and I've been looking for a chance to practice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh? Was the bed not comfortable?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: The bed is fine. It's just that I'm more used to sleeping in confined spaces. I feel safer that way.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I've already found a few suitable places. The small sofa. And inside the wardrobe.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: And since there aren't any cats here to come and scratch me because I've taken their favorite spot, every night is a good night's sleep.

choices.text: Uh-oh... I actually do have cats.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Oh... In that case, I'll let them have first pick and then I can find somewhere else. I wouldn't want to scare 'em...

choices.text: Don't worry, my cats don't scare easily.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: They're more than welcome!

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Starting tonight, I'll be sure to leave a little space before I go to sleep.

choices.text: They'll probably try to curl up beside you.
I'll make you your own little "lair"!

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Will you draw one for me, like Albedo? W—Would that be too much trouble?

choices.text: I'm sorry, I'm not that good at alchemy.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: I've never had a lair like this before... I'll treasure it.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Please, allow me to help you!

choices.text: But I can make one myself, no sweat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Of course I would! Opportunities such as this are rare.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Based on my observations, it seems adventurers have very little free time... And you're probably busier than most.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And how did you come by these observations?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I like to stroll the streets of Mondstadt in my spare time, listening to people talk and watching people as they go about their day.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Passing by the Adventurers' Guild, I've noticed that adventurers always run up to the counter and stop for only a moment to talk before hurrying on their way once more.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, I suppose everyone has something they want or need to do.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Albedo and Sucrose often get so caught up in their research that they forget to eat and sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: As for Master Jean, well, need I say more? And then there are others who are busy practicing their swordwork, or singing, or even drinking and making merry...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Compared to them, I sometimes feel like only my form is human, and I'm still out of place...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Do you think I should find something to keep myself busy too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any life goals?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Well, there are many things I'm interested in, but I wouldn't go so far as to say they're my "life goals."

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: At least for me, I don't think you can call something your "life"-anything unless it's some kind of incredible achievement, right?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: The heroes in most stories all have momentous, earth-shattering lifetime accomplishments.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You shouldn't compare yourself to others. Just be yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: But... I want to grow a little faster too, to become someone everyone accepts.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: After all, the fact that my own "story" has come this far is the result of a lot of people's hard work.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: If the "ending" is anticlimactic, if it doesn't have some sort of positive impact on this world, then I'll have let everyone down...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I'm sure Mother would want to see me become someone remarkable, too...

choices.text: I think she'd want to see a happy you.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: I think I'm starting to understand what you mean. Thank you.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Uhm... I've still got a lot of difficult questions floating around my head. I still need to spend a lot of time thinking them over...

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Being busy thinking... Maybe that's the best kind of busy for me.

choices.text: As long as you're happy, you won't have let anyone down.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: While taking a stroll nearby, I discovered a relatively empty space, with no major buildings nearby or things on the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: May I practice my fighting skills there?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I've recently gained fresh insights into harnessing the power within me, and I'd like to put in some more practice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course you can! Want me to join you?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Huh? You'd be willing to train with me?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: But... be careful, alright? I don't often get the chance to train in a safe, isolated environment... I wanna try unleashing my full power.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Doing so might be dangerous... Are you sure you want to be there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's that? Are you questioning my abilities?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Of course not!

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: It's just... I'm still not sure where my limits are, and if I lose control...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Fine, the truth is... I'm scared of making a fool of myself in front of you.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: That's a normal thing to worry about, right? Humans seem to care a lot about how other people see them...

choices.text: I once saw a great toy dragon crying and wailing...

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Alright, that's enough! You can stop there!

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Just... take care of me, okay?

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: I must admit, whether in real battle or in training, I feel so much safer when you're around.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Before I came here, Hat Guy sent me a letter telling me that that would be the case.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Really? What else did he say?

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: He also said, "If you don't want trouble, then stay out of other people's business."

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: But it's not like he follows his own advice there, so I don't plan to either.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Haha, spot on!

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Besides, I doubt you could avoid meddling even if you tried.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Me? How are we on me now?

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: My friends in Mondstadt told me all about your adventures. It sounds like you like meddling in other people's affairs even more than Hat Guy.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Mother once wrote in the narration, "Sticking one's nose into other people's beeswax is exactly what a hero does."

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: The way I see it, you're this world's hero.

choices.text: He tried to hit me through his tears... and missed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Durin.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Good morning. I just went to check on that little bird... Or should I say, big bird?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: She wakes up so early. What does she eat for breakfast?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Does she like to eat bread or...? What about grain?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Durin.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: If you're having trouble sleeping, just wake me up.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Mother read me so many bedtime stories, I can tell them to you.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: This place reminds me of the study Miss Lisa set up for me when I was learning to read and write.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: She said that human writing needs to be appreciated slowly and with a calm mind, so it's important to shut out all noise. When I was in that study, I felt like I could sit and read forever.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Ah, honestly, I'm still learning. Would it be alright with you if I come here whenever I want to read?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: This place reminds me of when I first arrived in Nod-Krai...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: It is a mysterious place. Sometimes the rain flies up toward the sky, and the flowers and plants by the roadside shy away from me... Everything there is so different compared to Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: But going to faraway places is like reading an unfamiliar story. Such wondrous surprises are exactly the kind of experience that only a new book can provide.
